selectedAssets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: referenced Dai Viet game character atlas. Keep EXACTLY original FOUR columns by FOUR rows, 1536x1024. Sixteen complete intact figures. Columns preserve original SE, SW, NE, NW headings, rows preserve four original identities, faces, tunics, equipment. KEEP THE ENTIRE UPPER BODY ABOVE TUNIC HEM, head, arms, weapon and colors matching the input. Do not change camera or reverse facing. Redraw complete anatomically connected legs beneath tunic, never floating fragments. No labels, borders, ground, shadows or scenery, truly transparent background. Leave each whole person inside its own 384x256 cell. CHANGE ONLY THE LEG POSES of all 16 figures into a NARROW PASSING STEP. The near leg is VERTICAL straight down from hip, foot flat on ground directly BELOW HIP. The far knee is flexed softly and foot lifts just behind/opposite calf, passing close to the standing ankle. Both knees are near each other and BOTH FEET ARE CLOSE under the body; almost no horizontal stride width. ABSOLUTELY NO WIDE V STRIDE, no leg extended diagonally in front. This is the passing pose between long contacts, not standing with both feet flat.
